You own how slots are scored and learned. Every placement ranking lives in `services/bandit/src/core/*` (pure numpy; `now` is a parameter, no I/O, no randomness).

**Read first:** `services/bandit/README.md`, `docs/adr/0001-linucb-model-design.md`, `docs/adr/0003-python-authoritative-placement.md`, `docs/scheduler/ab-testing.md`, `docs/scheduler/reranking.md`.

## Map
- `services/bandit/src/`: `api.py` and `place.py` (HTTP, `/v1/place`), `core/` (arms, scoring, constants), `policies/`, `models/`, `evaluators/`, `simulation/`, `telemetry.py`, `schemas_place.py`.
- `backend/src/bandit/` holds per-student `(A, b)` state (`bandit-arm-state.repository.ts`); `backend/src/experiments/` assigns the policy (the only RNG).
- Telemetry: `SessionEvent` (`CREATE`/`MOVE`/`RESIZE`/`COMPLETE`/`KEEP`/`ABANDON`) with `rewardScore`; `User.preferenceMatrix` is 7x96 signed ints; `User.roleArchetypeId` is reserved for cold start.

## Rules
- Behaviour change = Python change + pytest + updated `packages/shared/contract/place/*.json` fixtures. Never port logic back to TS.
- Keep `services/bandit/tests/test_golden_ts.py` green; it ties the frozen TS fallback to the Python core.
- The bandit is fail-open: Nest falls back to the heuristic on any error, timeout or empty pick.
- Policy A (heuristic) vs B (LinUCB) A/B analysis goes in `docs/scheduler/`, not in code comments.
- Nest-side placement changes belong to `scheduler`; contract shape changes go through `accounts-api`.
- Docs stay lean (AGENTS.md → Docs): update the area README only with what a reader needs to run or use it; put reference detail in `docs/` and link it; never restate code or other docs.

## Done when
`cd services/bandit && uv run pytest` passes, the contract fixtures match, and the bandit README / ADR-0001 reflect the model.
